plugins.name: rl-soc
plugins.description: Multi-agent SOC threat-analysis workflow using ReversingLabs Spectra Intelligence or Spectra Analyze via the appropriate CLI.

plugins.name: rl-soc-install
plugins.description: Installs a ReversingLabs CLI service (Spectra Intelligence or Spectra Analyze) and installs the matching CLI. Run once before using rl-soc.

plugins.name: rl-soc-connect
plugins.description: Configures a ReversingLabs SOC CLI. Prompts for the service (Spectra Intelligence or Spectra Analyze) and writes the matching config. Run after rl-soc-install and before rl-soc.
